original.statement: Cilium 1.17.0 adds a new metric, `cilium_operator_unmanaged_pods`, listed under "Added Metrics" in the 1.17 upgrade notes.

decision.reason: [ev-b182e7794768] lists `cilium_operator_unmanaged_pods` under "1.17 Upgrade Notes › Added Metrics", next to other new metrics ([ev-b598b51801ea], [ev-b66b29e5567d]). It names no setting, flag or values key that controls the metric. With no such gate in the evidence, the right exposure is every environment upgrading from a version before 1.17.0, which is what edge-from-version <1.17.0 says. The evidence states no extra condition, such as operator metrics being enabled, so adding one would mean guessing.
